'''Derra-114 protocol''' was a code encryption used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime before the [[Battle of Folor]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s forces managed to crack the code.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

During the battle, [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Kell Tainer]] devised a ploy to divert [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Apwar Trigit]]'s capital ship, [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']], away from the main engagement in order to allow the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Borleias (transport)|''Borleias'']] to launch. He along with fellow Wraith [[Hohass Ekwesh]], [[Blue Squadron (New Republic)|Blue Squadron]] pilots [[Dorset Konnair]] and [[Tetengo Noor]], used the Derra-114 protocol and pretended to be [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] escorted by members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. Similar to broadcasting in the open, their comm transmissions were picked up by ''Implacable''. Trigit decided to capture the famous rebel heroes and ordered his ship to head to their position, away from the battle.<ref name="WS" />
